auditor_value: (x, y) = (2v₀² tanθ / g, −2v₀² tan²θ / g); landing time t = 2v₀ tanθ / g

findings.quote: Writing the incline's equation the wrong way round, x = y tanθ instead of y = x tanθ, which changes the tanθ power in the landing time and coordinates.
findings.note: Imprecise: in the solution's own axes the correct hill line is y = −x tanθ (step 2), not y = x tanθ, so the entry names a form that contradicts the worked step; and 'changes the tanθ power' is an unclear way of saying tanθ becomes cotθ.
findings.fix: Writing the hill's equation with the angle on the wrong side, y = −x cotθ (that is x = −y tanθ) instead of y = −x tanθ, which replaces every tanθ in the landing time and coordinates by cotθ.
